examples.text: Faut-il pour autant se gausser des micronations? «Elles ont toutes un point commun, plaide Fabrice O'Driscoll, webmestre du site de l'Institut français de micropatrologie.
examples.translation: Should we, however, make fun of micronations? "They all have one thing in common," argues Fabrice O’Driscoll, webmaster of the website of the French Institute of Micropatrology.
examples.english: Should we, however, make fun of micronations? "They all have one thing in common," argues Fabrice O’Driscoll, webmaster of the website of the French Institute of Micropatrology.

examples.text: Le micronationalisme tend peu à peu à devenir une discipline et un sujet d'études à part entière. Certains diront même qu'il s'agit d'ores-et-déjà d'un sujet d'étude, des universitaires comme O'Driscoll ayant défendu le concept de micropatrologie ou micropatriologie (étude des micronations et micro-États).
examples.translation: Micronationalism is gradually tending to become a discipline and a subject of study in its own right. Some will even say that it is already a subject of study, academics like O'Driscoll having defended the concept of micropatrology or micropatriology (study of micronations and micro-states).
examples.english: Micronationalism is gradually tending to become a discipline and a subject of study in its own right. Some will even say that it is already a subject of study, academics like O'Driscoll having defended the concept of micropatrology or micropatriology (study of micronations and micro-states).

examples.text: Des conférences (accès libre et gratuit) vont ponctuer les sessions. Le planning : « Micronation : réflexion sur la pertinence d’une nation au sein d’une nation », de la géographe et sociologue Sandra Petermann (samedi à 10 heures), […] « Micropatrologie : Science sociohumaine » (à 16 heures) et enfin « Micronations et formes artistiques » (16 h 30) par le plasticien Gilles Zinck.
examples.translation: The sessions (free admission) will be dotted by lectures. On the agenda: "Micronation: reflections on the relevance of a nation within a nation", by geographer and sociologist Sandra Petermann (Saturday at 10 a.m.), […] "Micropatrology: a socio-human science" (at 4 p.m.) and finally "Micronations and artistic forms" (4.30 p.m.) by visual artist Gilles Zinck.
